correctness.rationale: The odd-characteristic difference map (a,b)->(a-b,a^2-b^2) is bijective on the ordered off-diagonal pairs and all pairs with nonzero first difference. Fourier orthogonality yields exactly trace squared plus off-diagonal Hilbert–Schmidt energy, with no missing normalizations. The two nonnegative sum-of-squares deficits prove both inequalities and equality criteria for all Hermitian A. Diagonal and Fourier-conjugated matrices realize the sharp endpoints at arbitrary fixed spectra. The orthogonal Hermitian decomposition yields singular values sqrt(q), 1 and 0 with stated real multiplicities. Projector substitution establishes the r-orthonormal result. Finite packaged checker passes 1915 assertions but is not an all-prime-power certificate.
